transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer service, my name is Morag. How may I assist you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Morag. I've received a parcel in the post with a green adapter plug for our landline phone, but I am terrified to touch it because of my wife's emergency medical care alarm.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly guide you through setting up that Digital Voice adapter and make sure your wife's care alarm is completely safe, Angus. May I take your account number?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is SN 820 5519, under Angus MacIntyre.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Angus. For security, could you please confirm your full installation address and your four-digit account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: We are at 45 Deeside Gardens, Aberdeen, AB15 7PT. And the security PIN is 3814.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That has verified your account, thank you. You have our Fibre 50 broadband and Digital Voice home landline transition plan.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, following the letter about the old copper network closing down.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So to make sure I understand your concerns completely: you have received the Digital Voice telephone adapter for the national copper retirement, but you need certainty that your wife's telecare pendant will work properly before switching cables, is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, exactly that. My wife had a stroke last year, and her red SOS button connects through a Tunstall Lifeline box into the wall phone socket. If that fails to dial the monitoring warden, it could literally be a matter of life and death.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand how critical and frightening that is for you both, Angus. Please do not worry. We will check the telecare certification and do a live alarm test together before we finish today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Morag, you have no idea what a relief it is to hear you say that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What is the exact model number printed on the base of your wife's Tunstall telecare unit? Is it a Lifeline Vi or Vi Plus?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me look underneath the white unit... it says 'Tunstall Lifeline Vi Plus' on the silver label.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for a couple of minutes while I check the telecare compatibility register for Tunstall devices and verify our VoIP exchange codec settings.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, I will hold on.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Angus. I have reviewed the national telecare interoperability matrix for the Tunstall Lifeline Vi Plus.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What does the official register say, Morag?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The Lifeline Vi Plus is fully certified for S-Net Digital Voice using standard dual-tone multi-frequency signaling over our G.711 uncompressed audio codec.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So it is designed to communicate properly over the internet line?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, completely. It communicates with the Aberdeen City Council monitoring center using the exact same tone frequencies as old copper wires.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What happens if there is a power cut on our street? That was my other big worry.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Because you have an emergency telecare alarm on the premises, you are entitled to our free Battery Backup Unit, which keeps the router and adapter powered for over one hour during a blackout.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Was that the black rectangular power bank included in the postal box?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, precisely! That is an uninterruptible power supply. It plugs between the wall socket and your Hub to ensure continuous operation.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is so sensible. I didn't realise what that black box was for.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let's connect everything together step by step. Have you got the small green telephone adapter that came in the parcel?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I have it right here in my hand. It has a green phone plug on one end.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Look at the back of your S-Net broadband Hub. You will see a green telephone socket labeled 'TEL 1'. Plug that green plug firmly into TEL 1.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay... pushing the green plug into the green socket labeled TEL 1... clicked in firmly with a little click.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now look at the white Tunstall Lifeline unit on the hallway table. Its telephone lead is currently plugged into the old BT wall master socket, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is plugged into the master telephone socket on the skirting board.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Unplug that standard telephone plug from the wall socket, and plug it directly into the receiving end of the green adapter cable from the Hub.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Squeezing the little clip... unplugged from the wall socket... and pushing it firmly into the green adapter socket... clicked in!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And is your standard cordless home telephone handset plugged into the secondary extension socket on the back of the Tunstall unit?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the cordless phone has always been daisy-chained through the back of the alarm box.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now, pick up your cordless telephone handset and listen to the earpiece. You should hear a clear, uninterrupted digital dial tone.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Lifting the receiver to my ear... oh, yes! A crystal clear dial tone! It sounds much clearer than our old crackly line!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to verify after that switchover, Angus: is the green status LED on the Tunstall Lifeline unit showing solid green without any red fault light?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, a steady solid green light on the front of the Lifeline box.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now comes the most important part of our test. Please press the red emergency SOS button on your wife's wearable pendant or on the main unit.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, pressing the big red circular button on the Lifeline unit now... it has started beeping and dialling.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Stay on the line with me. The speaker on the unit will announce the call connection and the operator will answer via the hands-free speaker.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's ringing through... a voice over the speaker is saying 'Aberdeen Community Alarm, operator 12 speaking, Mrs MacIntyre are you okay?'

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Speak to the operator and let them know you are doing an authorized Digital Voice installation test with your telecoms provider.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Speaking to the operator now... 'Hello, this is Angus MacIntyre, we are just testing our new digital adapter with S-Net'... She says the signal received is 100 percent clear with full two-way audio!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is absolutely fantastic! The emergency telecare protocol has transmitted, handshaked, and verified two-way speech flawlessly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The operator has logged the successful test and disconnected. A huge weight has just lifted off my chest, Morag.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So to confirm, Angus: your Digital Voice adapter is installed, the landline dial tone is clear, and your wife's emergency telecare pendant has been live-tested and verified with the warden?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, 100 percent resolved. You have been so patient, kind, and knowledgeable. I was dreading this call all morning.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am so glad we could give you complete peace of mind, Angus. I have recorded the successful telecare integration on your account profile so our engineering team has full visibility.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's wonderful. And the old copper wall socket is just left alone now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the old wall socket is completely decommissioned. Everything now routes reliably through your optical fibre broadband connection.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Understood. The white box on the skirting board can just stay empty.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And remember, your battery backup unit is fully charged and will automatically kick in if there is any power interruption in Deeside Gardens.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Knowing that battery is sitting there gives me such confidence during winter storms.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else regarding your broadband, home phone service, or billing that I can assist you with today, Angus?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that was everything. You have been an absolute angel today, Morag.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was my sincere pleasure to help you and your wife, Angus. Please pass on my warmest regards to Mrs MacIntyre.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I certainly will. Have a wonderful day!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Angus. Take care and goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, goodbye!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Angus. Have a wonderful day.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Morag.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye, take care.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Take care.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have a lovely rest of your day, Angus.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You too, Morag.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: All the best to your family in Aberdeen.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All the best.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We are always here if you ever have any questions about your digital phone line.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is so good to know.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Take care of yourself and Mrs MacIntyre, Angus.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will do, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have a lovely evening.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You too.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye, Angus.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Morag.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Angus. Goodbye.
